const c=document.querySelector('canvas'); const d=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data; let out=[]; for(let y=0;y<c.height;y+=3){let r='';for(let x=0;x<c.width;x+=3){const i=(y*c.width+x)*4; const v=(d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2])/3; r+= (d[i+3]>0&&v<120)?'#':'.';} out.push(r);} return out.join('\n');
